intro: Holiday Party Wednesday! The SPY Board threw its 2026 holiday bash (Stocktwits hosting, muppets attending), our guy filed his own personal financial audit, and he called a parabolic run in tomorrow's sick-day chart. Add a feral chungus and a round of GMs, and the season of festive chaos has officially begun!

items.caption: The SPY Board's 2026 holiday party has arrived, muppet-style, and he gave Stocktwits a classy thank-you for hosting. Top post of the day by a mile. Save us a seat at the snack table!
items.quote: $SPY $TSLA  Here is the 2026 SPY Board muppets holiday party. THanks @Stocktwits for hosting.

items.caption: The Pentagon failed its audit, so he bravely came forward with his own. Only $1.05 hundred out of $3.42 hundred accounted for? That's transparency, folks!
items.quote: BREAKING: I have also failed my financial audit.  Of my $3.42 hundred in assets, only $1.05 hundred could be accounted for.

items.caption: Forget the SPY chart. The real breakout is happening in Thursday sick days, and he's calling it parabolic. Chart analyst of the year!
items.quote: $SPY The chart of people calling in sick tomorrow is going parabolic!

items.caption: Two words, one photo, endless mystery: "Feral chungus." The chonk content we're all here for!
Morning roll call, with a picture! Good mornings for everybody, the friendliest way to open the timeline.
When @EricRSammons said he'd never been paid for an X post (and never would be offered), our guy summed it up in one word. Solidarity among unpaid posters!
Spotted a very satisfying clip on @HabitualLinest's timeline and went straight to business plan mode. Always thinking like an entrepreneur!
items.quote: @HabitualLinest He could charge people money to do this.
